title: Attention U-Net Cellular Automata for Multi-Class Land Use and Land Cover Change Simulation in Lucknow, India: Evaluation Against Null and Classical Baselines
abstract: arXiv:2611.19348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Convolutional networks are often used to learn the transition rules of land-use cellular automata (CA), yet their predictions are seldom compared with a null model that predicts no change. We built AttentionUNet-CA, which reads a 32 x 32 neighbourhood of land-cover states with four drivers (elevation, distance to major roads, distance to the central business district (CBD) and population density) and predicts the state of each cell ten years later. We tested it on Lucknow, India, with GLC_FCS30D land cover for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, a 30 m series mapped consistently over time, and compared its built-up class with GHSL and ESA WorldCover. AttentionUNet-CA was trained on 1990-2010, selected on held-out spatial blocks and evaluated once on 2010-2020, with three seeds. Baselines were the null model, a random-forest CA (RF-CA) and a U-Net CA without attention; each network was trained with and without class weights. Only 8.1% of the study

translated_title: 用于印度勒克瑙多类土地利用与土地覆盖变化模拟的注意力U-Net元胞自动机：与零模型及经典基线的对比评估
translated_abstract: 卷积网络常被用于学习土地利用元胞自动机（CA）的转换规则，但其预测结果很少与预测“无变化”的零模型进行比较。我们构建了AttentionUNet-CA，该模型读取32×32邻域的土地覆盖状态及四个驱动因素（海拔、距主要道路的距离、距中央商务区（CBD）的距离以及人口密度），并预测每个单元格十年后的状态。我们在印度勒克瑙对其进行了测试，使用了1990年、2000年、2010年和2020年的GLC_FCS30D土地覆盖数据（这是一套30米分辨率、跨时间一致制图的数据序列），并将其建成用地类别与GHSL和ESA WorldCover进行了对比。AttentionUNet-CA在1990-2010年的数据上训练，在留出的独立空间区块上进行模型选择，并在2010-2020年上进行一次性评估，共使用三个随机种子。基线包括零模型、随机森林元胞自动机（RF-CA）以及不含注意力机制的U-Net CA；每个网络分别在有类别权重和无类别权重两种设置下训练。研究区中仅有8.1%……
tldr: 提出AttentionUNet-CA模型，将注意力U-Net与元胞自动机结合用于模拟印度勒克瑙的多类土地利用与土地覆盖变化，并强调必须与零模型及经典基线进行严格对比评估。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AttentionUNet-CA, an attention U-Net-driven cellular automaton for multi-class land use and land cover change simulation in Lucknow, India, rigorously evaluated against null and classical baselines.
